prompt_template: Seamless tileable texture swatch of {subject}, {view}, filling the whole square edge to edge. Evenly lit with no shadows, no vignette and no lighting gradient; no objects, no border, no frame, no text. Flat cel-shaded tones with two or three hard-edged shades per material and dark ink lines, in the muted, dark gothic palette of a night-time village.

views.floor: seen straight from above (orthographic top-down, no perspective)
views.wall: seen straight on as a flat elevation (orthographic, no perspective)
views.roof: seen straight onto the roof plane (orthographic top-down, no perspective)

cobbles.subject: worn, uneven rounded cobblestones in cold slate and pewter greys with dark ink joints and a few tufts of dark moss in the cracks, about twelve cobbles across

mud_road.subject: a muddy dirt path: lumpy, uneven dark brown mud with small stones, a few footprints and small dark puddles reflecting a blue night sky, no straight lines, stripes or ruts

grass.subject: sparse, dying dark green grass and moss clumps over dark earth, with a few dead brown leaves, muted bog greens

house_wall.subject: an old Barovian house wall: cracked, stained bone-coloured plaster panels between dark brown timber framing beams (vertical posts, one horizontal rail and diagonal braces), about two panels across

roof_slate.subject: a roof of overlapping dark slate tiles in staggered rows, cool grey-blue, some chipped or cracked, dark ink outlines, about ten tiles across

roof_thatch.subject: an old straw thatch roof: dense, matted, weathered straw in dull tan and dark brown bands, darkened with damp and patches of moss

wood_planks.subject: a floor of worn dark walnut-brown wooden planks running vertically, eight planks across, with knots, nail heads and dark ink gaps between the boards, staggered plank ends

rug.subject: an old woven rug with a repeating geometric folk pattern of diamonds and crosses in faded crimson, wine red, dark umber and bone; the pattern fills the whole square edge to edge with no rug border or fringe

plaster_wall.subject: an interior wall of old cracked, stained parchment-coloured plaster with a few patches where the plaster has fallen away to show dark red-brown bricks

wainscot_wall.subject: an interior wall: dark walnut wooden wainscot panelling on the lower half (raised panels and a moulded top rail) and faded wine-red damask wallpaper on the upper half, the panelling repeating across the width
wainscot_wall.note: Wraps in x only: map V from 0 at the top of the wall to 1 at the floor, one tile per wall height.

stone_flags.subject: a church floor of large worn rectangular grey stone flagstones of irregular sizes, dark ink joints and a few cracks

stone_wall.subject: a church wall of large cut grey stone blocks laid in courses, weathered, dark ink mortar lines, a few cracks and dark moss stains

cobbled_square.subject: a town square paved with neat small rounded cobblestones laid in overlapping fan-shaped arcs, cold greys with darker joints

palisade_logs.subject: a palisade wall of tall vertical pine logs standing side by side, dark brown bark, about seven logs across, with a horizontal iron band; the logs run off the top and bottom edges (no pointed tops visible)

house_wall.subject: a Vallaki townhouse wall of weathered horizontal wooden clapboards painted a faded grey-blue, the paint peeling in places to show dark wood, dark ink lines between boards

stone_floor.subject: a dungeon floor of rough, uneven dark grey stone slabs, cold and damp, with dark ink joints, cracks and a little grit

stone_wall.subject: a dungeon wall of rough-hewn dark grey stone blocks in uneven courses, damp, with dark ink mortar lines

damp_brick.subject: a damp cellar wall of old dark red-brown bricks with dark mortar, wet patches, and streaks of green slime and moss running down

water.subject: the dark still water of a forest pool at night: deep blue-black water with faint ripples, a few pale moonlit glints and dark reflections, no lily pads, no shore
